sources.agency: California State Water Resources Control Board
sources.program: Freshwater and Estuarine Harmful Algal Bloom (FHAB) Program
sources.attribution: Advisory data: California State Water Resources Control Board, Freshwater Harmful Algal Bloom Program, via data.ca.gov (public domain). Advisories are recommendations; reporting is voluntary and incomplete.
sources.lift_explanation: An advisory ends only when the state records a later "None" (no advisory recommended) at the same spot, or an end date. A blank end date is unknown.

sources.program: Harmful Algal Bloom Response (public water bodies)
sources.rights: Use permitted with the required disclaimer; revocable by the State
sources.attribution: Missouri data: Missouri Department of Natural Resources, Harmful Algal Bloom response map. Status codes are the department's; their plain-English labels here are this site's reading of the codes.
sources.lift_explanation: An advisory ends only when the department records a dissipation date. A closed case without one is not read as an end.
sources.required_disclaimer: The data made available here has been modified for use from its original source, which is the State of Missouri. THE STATE OF MISSOURI EXPRESSLY DISCLAIMS ALL WARRANTIES, WHETHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING ANY IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. The data is subject to change as modifications and updates are complete. It is understood that the information contained in the Web feed is being used at one’s own risk.
sources.revocation_clause: The State of Missouri reserves the right to modify and/or discontinue providing any or all of the data feeds at any time and to require the termination of any and all displaying, distributing or otherwise using any or all of the data for any reason including, without limitation, your violation of any provision of these Terms of Use.

sources.program: Cyanobacteria Assessment Network (CyAN), Sentinel-3 OLCI weekly composite
sources.license: U.S. Government work (public domain under 17 U.S.C. § 105); no license is stated on the CyANWeb API
sources.rights: EPA calls CyANWeb experimental and provisional, a research-level tool
sources.attribution: Satellite estimates: U.S. EPA Cyanobacteria Assessment Network (CyAN), from Copernicus Sentinel-3 data. Provisional, research-level estimates; EPA does not endorse this site.
sources.contact: U.S. EPA Office of Research and Development
sources.lift_explanation: A satellite estimate is never an advisory and never ends one. It measures how much cyanobacteria there is, not toxins.
